# Sample Size Calculations

Target: 90% power at α = 0.05

Note: `n` here represents the number of questions (the unit of resampling in
the cluster bootstrap). This assumes one comparison per question. If multiple
raters evaluate the same question, the effective sample size is closer to the
number of questions than the total number of ratings.

```{r sample_size_calc, cache=TRUE}
set.seed(123)

alt_distribution <- c(
  0.65,
  0.20,
  0.15
)

sample_sizes <- seq(20, 200, by = 20)
num_replicates <- 500
n_boot <- 1000
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.90

powers <- sapply(sample_sizes, function(n) {
  calc_power(n, alt_distribution, alpha = alpha,
             num_replicates = num_replicates, n_boot = n_boot)
})

power_results <- tibble(
  n = sample_sizes,
  power = powers
)

power_results %>%
  kable(caption = "Power by sample size (D = 0.50 under alternative)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

```{r power_plot}
ggplot(power_results, aes(x = n, y = power)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = target_power, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "Sample size (number of comparisons)",
    y = "Power",
    title = "Power curve for favorability score test",
    subtitle = sprintf("Alternative: D = %.2f, α = %.2f, target = %.0f%%",
                       alt_distribution[1] - alt_distribution[3], alpha, 100 * target_power)
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r min_sample_size}
min_n <- power_results %>%
  filter(power >= target_power) %>%
  slice_min(n) %>%
  pull(n)

if (length(min_n) == 0) {
  cat("Target power not achieved in tested range. Increase maximum sample size.\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("Minimum sample size for %.0f%% power: n = %d\n", 100 * target_power, min_n))
}
```
